Author: Akari
Name: Venue Helper
Punchline: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
Description: An all-in-one venue host toolkit: Venue Counter (multi-venue attendance + lifetime time tracking), Raffle Helper, Auction Helper (with buyer tracking), Giveaway Helper, DR Tourny Helper (single or double elimination), Shout/Yell Helper, Bar Game Helper (custom roll games + survival modes with fixed/tiered/high-score payouts), and Menu Helper (per-venue menus with macro-style serve sequences). Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh). Exports to TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX.
